title: review
description: Stage output contract: the PR was reviewed against the task goal and code quality.

tests_meaningful.description: independent test-validate verdict (#13): do the change's tests meaningfully exercise it (would they fail if it regressed)? An explicit false rejects the review even when approved — the reviewer is a different agent from the one that wrote the tests, which is the point

severity.description: suggestion-only rejections auto-approve (the severity gate); critical/important drive the fix cycle

issues.description: blocking issues (empty when approved). Prefer the structured object form — severity gates disposition, file/line/suggested_fix make the fix cycle actionable

non_blocking.description: findings that do NOT block approval but should be tracked as follow-ups; the engine files each as a deferred-scope issue at finalize (empty if none)

improvement.description: self-improvement loop: the single highest-value forward-looking improvement this task suggests for the PROJECT/roadmap (not a fix for this PR). The engine files it as an enhancement issue at finalize. Omit if none stands out.

retrospective.description: self-improvement loop: one lesson this task teaches about the ORCHESTRATION PROCESS (prompts/stages/tooling/lanes), not the code. Rendered in the completion note. Omit if none.

detail.description: what we learned / what to change
